entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane drowning in mana where magic is commonplace and mana-created creatures, including great dragons, still roam.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: A planeswalker and Shandalar's most skillful wizard and protector, nearly immortal, who trains two adepts and later hands his power to the Guardian.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: An insanely cunning necromancer who stabbed Sahrmal, led an undead army in Lim-Dûl's War, and was later imprisoned in an artifact.

entities.name: Azaar
entities.description: Sahrmal's pupil who stole and cast a great spell in Ardestan, was possessed by Lim-Dûl, and was buried.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: Sahrmal's unnamed second pupil, made immortal and named his replacement as protector of Shandalar.

entities.name: Lichlord Skavius Sian
entities.description: The undead name taken by Azaar's risen body, who commands the Black Guild.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: An extraordinarily powerful planeswalker who covets Shandalar and manipulates the Guild Lords into revolt.

entities.name: Alsadim K'mer
entities.description: One of the current Guild Lords who strikes down the Guardian.

entities.name: Starcryst
entities.description: One of the current Guild Lords who strikes down the Guardian.

entities.name: Morgane
entities.description: One of the current Guild Lords who strikes down the Guardian.

entities.name: Kzzy'n
entities.description: One of the current Guild Lords who strikes down the Guardian.

entities.name: The Elderly Oneiromancer
entities.description: An elderly woman touched by the Guardian's spirit who divines Arzakon's real plan and convinces the novice.

entities.name: The Novice
entities.description: A wandering amateur spellcaster, the player character, who is all that stands between Shandalar and doom.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: The greatest city of Shandalar and its last bastion, besieged by Lim-Dûl and left in ruins.

entities.name: The Great Barrier
entities.description: A barrier around Shandalar created by Azaar's spell, powered by the confinement of Lim-Dûl's spirit.

entities.name: The Guilds of Shandalar
entities.description: Five guilds, one for each color of magic, that teach and police magic use, each led by a Guild Lord.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: The long war in which Lim-Dûl's undead army devastated Shandalar.

entities.name: The Wizards' War
entities.description: The war in which the Guardian and the Guilds defeated Lim-Dûl a second time.

entities.name: The Spell of Dominion
entities.description: A spell Arzakon claims grants immortality and total dominion over a plane, but which would destroy the artifact holding Lim-Dûl and shatter the barrier.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl and two planeswalkers escape imprisonment in the Shard and arrive on Shandalar; Sahrmal drives off all but Lim-Dûl, who stabs the weakened hero with a pitchfork before the followers behead him.
events.quote: The necromancer chose the aftermath of that battle as an advantageous moment to pierce Kenan Sahrmal with a pitchfork.

events.summary: Twelve years later Lim-Dûl returns with an undead army and wages a years-long war that destroys every major city but one.
events.quote: Lim-Dûl reappeared with an army of the undead at his side and attempted to seize dominion over the entire plane.

events.summary: Sahrmal, nearly powerless, secretly trains two adepts, Azaar and a nameless one, to defeat Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: Shandalar’s hero had been secretly training two adepts to take his place.

events.summary: Ardestan is besieged; Azaar flees his teacher's sanctuary to defend it and steals Sahrmal's great spell.
events.quote: Azaar fled their hidden sanctuary and went to the defense of Ardestan.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl waits on a rooftop to transfer his spirit into Azaar's body as Azaar prepares his casting.
events.quote: Huddled in the questionable refuge of a Circle of Protection

events.summary: Azaar's spell strikes Lim-Dûl's spirit while it occupies Azaar's body, raising the Great Barrier and imprisoning both.
events.quote: It worked, but Lim-Dûl was in Azaar’s body at the time.

events.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries Azaar's paralyzed body, where the two spirits war for control.
Sahrmal invests his remaining power in his second pupil, making him immortal, names him his replacement, vows to stay out of events and vanishes.
events.quote: Sahrmal named the nameless wizard as his replacement, took a vow to never again take an active part in events in Shandalar, then vanished.

events.summary: The new wizard declares himself The Guardian, immortal protector of Shandalar.
The Guardian establishes five guilds, one for each color, whose first leaders are chosen in a great contest and become Guild Lords.
events.quote: he established five guilds, one focused on each color of magic

events.summary: In the Wizards' War Lim-Dûl's spirit, having won over Azaar's, emerges to conquer Shandalar but is defeated; the Guardian imprisons him in an artifact.
events.quote: In the great Wizards' War , Lim-Dûl was defeated soundly, though the Lord of the Black Guild also fell.

events.summary: Azaar's emptied body rises as the undead Lichlord Skavius Sian and takes command of the Black Guild, while the Guardian hides the artifact.
events.quote: it rose of its own accord and stepped in to command the Black Guild, taking the name Lichlord Skavius Sian

events.summary: Arzakon traces the magical ripples to Shandalar and tries to penetrate the Great Barrier, but the Guardian repels it.
events.quote: the Guardian lent strength to the barrier and easily repelled Arzakon ’s physical intrusion

events.summary: At a conclave the five Guild Lords, manipulated by Arzakon, rise as one and strike down the Guardian.
events.quote: rose suddenly as one and struck down the Guardian

events.summary: Arzakon sets the Guild Lords a race to cast the Spell of Dominion, and their minions scour Shandalar seizing magical resources.
events.quote: Arzakon laid a task and a challenge before them.

events.summary: An elderly oneiromancer divines that Arzakon wants to conquer Shandalar itself and that the Spell of Dominion would destroy the artifact and shatter the barrier.
events.quote: Arzakon intends to conquer Shandalar himself.

events.summary: The oneiromancer convinces a wandering novice spellcaster, to whom the Guardian speaks briefly, making the novice Shandalar's last hope.
events.quote: Now, that lone figure is all that stands between Shandalar and its doom.
